sloka: लब्ध संज्ञः तु षड् रात्रात् विवशो विह्वलन् इव ।वीक्षमाणो दिशः सर्वा न अभिजानामि किंचन ॥४-६०-५॥
transliteration: labdha saṁjñaḥ tu ṣaḍ rātrāt vivaśo vihvalan iva ।vīkṣamāṇo diśaḥ sarvā na abhijānāmi kiṁcana ॥4-60-5॥

translations.english: Regaining consciousness after six nights, pale and bewildered, looking in every direction, I could recognize nothing.
